Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000323": As of 2025-04-09, Diego is off the Team Cinder on-call rotation.  (about: Team Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000314": The reporting service depends on the ledger.  (about: ledger, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000307": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000305" [decision]: As of 2025-04-04, the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000263": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000261" [constraint]: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000254": As of 2025-03-20, Team Dune owns the catalog service.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000250": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000246" [preference]: As of 2025-03-19, for anything Ember-related, page Oskar.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000201": The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.  (about: catalog service, indexer)
- memory_id "1000189" [constraint]: The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000156": During INC-2025-004, a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000135": The scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000129": Team Dune owns the reporting service.  (about: Team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000123": The resizer lives with Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, resizer)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000094": Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000053": As of January 2025, Team Dune consists of Farah alone.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000048": Farah runs Team Dune solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)

The note:

[2025-04-15] standup/dune/2025-04-15: If image-resizer is down, the product catalog is down: it relies on it for thumbnails.
